title: Insert with a pointer to a pointer
description:
Keep a sorted singly linked list, inserting with a `Node**`.

```
insert 5 2 8 1 9 -> 1 2 5 8 9
remove 5 -> 1 2 8 9
remove 1 (the head) -> 2 8 9
```
hints: `Node** link{head}; while (*link && (*link)->value < value) link = &(*link)->next;` then `*link = new Node{value, *link};` (lesson 3.02).
The same walk finds the link to change in `remove`: `Node* gone{*link}; *link = gone->next; delete gone;`.
requirements: `void insertSorted(Node** head, int value)` and `bool remove(Node** head, int value)`, each without a special case for the head.
Nodes are made with `new` and freed with `delete`; free the whole list at the end.
stretch: Reverse the list in place with three pointers.
